pin.estimand: Least-favourable, equal-tier-weighted mean token difference for the full verifier-at(vantage;tier) semantics across the original three tokenizer lineages, on sixteen fresh claims and vantages
admissibility_gates: exactly 16 unique pairs with zero overlap against the target original
each pair preserves the same claim, vantage, and evidence tier across both arms
the 6/5/5 item allocation is normalized to equal one-third weight per tier
both pinned tiktoken lineages and the exact public Gemma revision load and score every arm
every finite result is filed without post-count exclusions

manifest.method: For each fixed pair and tokenizer, delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english). Within each tokenizer, compute a mean for each of the three evidence tiers, then average those three tier means so tiers retain equal weight despite the 6/5/5 power-of-two allocation. The reported value is the least-favourable tokenizer mean, max(delta), matching the target original; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means. All finite results are filed.
manifest.seed: none - deterministic fixed pairs, committed before tokenizer loading
